summary.text: Joy Hohn is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 9 who took office on January 14, 2025, and a commercial pilot.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026, Republican primary and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Hohn was born in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, and earned a bachelor's degree from Augustana University in 1989.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she and her husband farm alongside her father, brother and children, raising corn, soybeans, cattle and buffalo, and that she has had a 40-year career as a professional pilot.
She also described herself as a lifelong Minnehaha County resident and said she had worked for nearly a decade on property rights issues.
In the 2025-2026 session Hohn is vice chair of the Senate Taxation Committee and serves on the Senate Commerce and Energy, Military and Veterans' Affairs, and Transportation committees.
In the survey, she named protecting constitutional rights and limiting taxes and government overreach among her key messages.
